Video showing it steaming continuously for at least 30–60 seconds and no water leakage.

response.reason: The item type is visible (steam iron), but the brand/model and key performance proof (steaming test) are not verifiable from the single photo. Without the rating label and a steaming video, a reliable worst-case price can’t be set confidently.
